# Axiom Hitbox Framework

> Production-grade documentation for Axiom Hitbox Framework

Version: 1.4.0

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/getting-started/installation): Installation options via Creator Store, GitHub Releases, and Wally package manager.
- [Quick Start](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/getting-started/quick-start): Step-by-step guide to creating your first server-authoritative melee hitbox.

## Core Concepts

- [Architecture & Authority](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/concepts/architecture): Server authority model and separation of infrastructure vs gameplay boundaries.
- [Hitbox Lifecycle](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/concepts/lifecycle): Finite state machine transitions (Idle, Active, Stopped, Cooldown) and object pooling.
- [Spatial Queries (Box & Sphere)](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/concepts/spatial-detection): Box and Sphere spatial detection algorithms and dynamic CFrame tracking.
- [Velocity Prediction](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/concepts/prediction): Linear, Angular, and LinearAngular velocity extrapolation to eliminate ping whiffs.
- [Continuous Attacks](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/concepts/continuous-attacks): HitResetInterval for continuous damage, channeling skills, lasers, and persistent auras.

## API Reference

- [Hitbox API](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/api/hitbox): Constructor, properties, signals, lifecycle methods, and state queries for Hitbox class.
- [Signal API](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/api/signal): Lightweight synchronous event primitive with FireFast and FireSafe dispatch.
- [Timer API](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/api/timer): Temporal infrastructure primitive backed by Scheduler.
- [Await Synchronization API](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/api/await): Coroutine synchronization, cancellation tokens, barriers, mutexes, and retry utilities.
- [CharacterService API](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/api/character-service): Type-safe LocalPlayer character and component access getters and signals.
- [Shared Types](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/api/types): Exported Luau type definitions for strict type checking.

## Guides & Patterns

- [Melee Combat System](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/guides/melee-combat): Building production-ready melee combos and hit detection.
- [Radial & Explosion AoE](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/guides/aoe-abilities): Spherical area-of-effect abilities and shockwave hitboxes.
- [Channeling & Auras](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/guides/channeling-auras): Persistent damage-over-time and aura fields.
- [Pooling & Performance](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/guides/pooling-performance): Zero-allocation hot paths and object recycling best practices.
- [Debug Visualizer](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/guides/debugging-visualizer): In-game visualizer parts for hitboxes during debugging.

## Development & Contributing

- [Contributing Guidelines](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/development/contributing): Development setup and coding guidelines.

- [Changelog](https://zAxn1e.github.io/axiom-hitbox/development/changelog): Version release notes and changes.
